nodes.label: SYSTEM.md: How GLUE works now
nodes.rationale: Comprehensive guide to GLUE's current architecture: pieces (Website, GLUE folder, GLUE Home, GLUE Cloud), data structures, state management, and all subsystems

nodes.label: Track: song with metadata
nodes.rationale: Core data entity: status (linked/missing/unlinked), rootId+relPath in music folder, importPath from DJ library, fileKey for copies, sources from DJ libraries, tags, info, rating, prep (Prepare tab), unwritten info.

nodes.label: Profile: artist alias
nodes.rationale: Artist alias: id, name, colour, BPM range. Signed in, account keeps the list (union of every device's profiles). Deleted profile is final everywhere. Each device keeps its own choice (lastAlias).

nodes.label: Collection: library unit
nodes.rationale: Unit containing music folders, DJ libraries, songs, playlists, analyses, events. Shown in sidebar views counting songs with analysisState function. Best copy shown, duplicates managed.

nodes.label: Shared collection: cloud sync form
nodes.rationale: Collection form for cloud sync: collection.json has shared, members (computer -> library folder), rootsBy (each computer's folders); songs have copies[computer]; same file on two computers is one song with a copy on each.

nodes.label: DJ library: Rekordbox, Engine DJ, Traktor
nodes.rationale: Music libraries from DJ apps: detected in folders user allows, imported bringing metadata first, music folders linked afterwards. Playlists come into GLUE on demand and stay linked. Live sync through GLUE Home.

nodes.label: Analysis: quality, BPM, key detection
nodes.rationale: Makes summary (verdict and tier, bandwidth, bit depth, BPM, key), full details, fingerprint, mini spectrogram, waveform. analysisState returns done/failed/waiting/elsewhere/nofile. Quality verdicts from Speklone's forensics.

nodes.label: Duplicates: fingerprints and nameGroups
nodes.rationale: Found by fingerprints (same recording) and artist+title with lengths within 3s (probable). Names compared one way everywhere (songName for Duplicates, fold for joining, bare for cover lookup). Only best copy shown; user can mark 'not a duplicate' or 'mark as duplicates'.

nodes.label: GLUE folder: JSON files, no database
nodes.rationale: User's data in JSON files (mco.json, profiles, collections, tracks, analysis, lists, sources, events, dupes, backups). Lowercase mco names from old name kept for compatibility. GLUE Home writes only while no lease held.
